resources.string: Continuous local collection without the phone
Beacon stores dish readings even when your phone is away. When the app reconnects to the same network, it syncs the pending records.

With firmware 0.1.0 installed on the ESP32:

1. Power Beacon near the phone.
2. Tap Set up Beacon.
3. Choose the discovered device and accept Android pairing.
4. Enter the local Wi-Fi network.
5. Wait for Beacon to appear on the network.

Slow pulse: starting
Blinking: waiting for pairing
Off: normal operation
Fast blinking: synchronization
Error pattern: problem
Hold for 5 s: open or restart BLE setup\nHold for 10 s: erase configuration and Beacon bonds
Alert when Beacon is not found on the local network
Alert when the dish is unreachable
Syncs with Beacon on the local network at approximate intervals to save battery. Closing the app keeps the schedule; force stop may pause it until the next launch.
